recipes.name: The Easiest Banana Bread (3 Ingredients)
instructions: Preheat your oven to 350°F (176°C). In a large mixing bowl, mash the bananas with a handheld mixer. Add the eggs and mix until combined, then whisk in the cake mix until fully combined.

Into a parchment paper-lined 9” x 5” non-stick loaf pan, pour in the batter and bake for 45-50 minutes, or until a toothpick or cake tester comes out clean. Let the cake cool and then slice and enjoy.
